description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetMenuConfigurator class, which configures menu items for the Employee Timesheet section within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It implements the MenuConfigurator interface and overrides the configure method to set the current screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet'.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the menu for Employee Timesheet in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, setting the relevant screen for the menu item.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the configure method to set the screen to 'viewEmployeeTimesheet' and returns null.
